title: What You Prompt Is What You Get: Increasing Transparency Using Prompt Cards
reasoning: The paper focuses on proposing a documentation framework called 'Prompt Cards' to improve transparency in prompt engineering. While it includes a specific 'Ethical considerations' section and uses the 'World Value Survey' (which involves societal values) as an illustrative example for its quantitative analysis, these components serve as demonstrations of the documentation methodology rather than a primary evaluation or benchmark of religious, moral, or ethical reasoning.
